Built to make your own.

How does the demo work?

All nine dashboards use local HTML and SVG fixtures. Arrows and keyboard controls switch views; the pause control stops autoplay. Email stays in this page and is never sent.

Where do I connect real data?

Replace the dashboard fixtures and the local form handler in app.js with your application’s data and account flow. Until then this is a presentation template.
